title: Batch-owned generated outputs leave paired rows stale after a clean witness
body: The d9 Undertow row at 50ec5098e8 had source schema/API changes but committed Codec.g.cs, ContentCodec.g.h, and packs remained at the prior wire version. Native boot first failed with CS7036 in generated Codec.g.cs; normal queued check-content-codegen.sh --write materialized v184 outputs and the boot passed, then the batch-owned outputs had to be restored to keep the exact row. The facade/landing flow should make paired generated publication and witness staging declarative.

title: Content codegen wrapper self-admits when nested under the queue
body: The documented check-content-codegen.sh --write invocation self-admits through the live queue and emits a warning when wrapped in with-test-lock.sh. A witness operator must know to run the script directly while still preserving queue admission. The facade should expose one queue-safe entry point or detect and reuse an existing grant without warning.
